parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: Timestamp for the throughput test, indicating when the test completed.

parameters.name: ClientMAC
parameters.description: MAC address of the STA that the throughput test ran to.

parameters.name: VID
parameters.description: The VLAN ID (VID) that the throughput test ran on. A value of 0 indicates that no VLAN was specified.

parameters.name: WMMUP
parameters.description: Wireless MultiMedia (WMM) User Priority (UP) {{bibref|WMM}} that the throughput test was requested to run on. A value of 8 indicates that no UP was specified.

parameters.name: TestDuration
parameters.description: Duration of the throughput test in {{units}}.

parameters.name: TestLayer
parameters.description: The OSI layer that the throughput test ran on.

parameters.name: TestAlgorithm
parameters.description: The test algorithm that the throughput test used.

parameters.name: DownlinkSpeed
parameters.description: Downlink speed found by the throughput test in {{units}}.

parameters.name: UplinkSpeed
parameters.description: Uplink speed found by the throughput test in {{units}}.

object.description: Object containing the results of the most recent throughput (speed) test from the BSS to a station (STA).
